text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. Looks like there are a whole 
bunch of promising contenders in today's 
mock race, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'm gonna learn everything I can 
from ya~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(I-I can't see! There're too many heads in 
the way, I can't tell what's happening in 
the race at all!!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Aaargh!! Missing such a legendary 
showdown is a massive blunder!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Is that it...? Was it a lesson telling me 
to grow bigger before studying races...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A dejected Tamamo Cross was unable to get 
back into rhythm during the training that 
followed.
